note: The parser copies attacker-controlled entry data into the fixed 512-byte orderly-RAM buffer based on the computed offset and size.
The reconstructed header is written back into the in-memory orderly-RAM array, and if the array is exactly full there is no space left for the expected zero-sized terminator/header sentinel.
On startup the code reloads the orderly-RAM image and later iterates it as a header-terminated list, so a missing terminator can drive incorrect processing of the NV entries.
